verdict.rationale: Puzzle is accounting software, so AR tracking is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only documents creating and branding invoices and matching invoices to payments. Nothing shows an accounts-receivable aging report or per-customer outstanding balances, and invoicing alone is an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances
